## About this dataset

This CMS public-use file compares inpatient discharges, average covered charges, average total payments, and average Medicare payments across hospitals and common Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Groups (MS-DRGs). It is useful for questions about geographic variation, hospital variation, charges versus payments, and service mix.

## File

| Table | Rows | One row represents | Primary key |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `legacy_cms_inpatient_charges_fy2011` | 163,065 | One hospital and MS-DRG combination with at least 11 discharges | `legacy_source_index` |

Provider fields identify the billing hospital and its location. `drg_definition` contains the MS-DRG code and description. Monetary columns are stored as numeric decimal values rather than currency-formatted text.

## Joining and enrichment

Use provider identifiers for hospital-level reference data only after checking that identifier definitions and time periods match. State fields support broad comparisons. Geographic or population reference files should be aggregated to a compatible area before joining.

## Important limitations

- The source contains only FY2011's 100 most frequently billed MS-DRGs.
- Hospital/MS-DRG combinations with 10 or fewer discharges are suppressed.
- The data do not describe all hospital services, all patients, commercial insurance, or current prices.
- Covered charges are not the same as negotiated prices, patient bills, hospital cost, or profit.
- An observational comparison of hospitals does not establish that a hospital caused a payment difference.

## Provenance and privacy

The source is the CMS Medicare Provider Charge Inpatient public-use file. It contains hospital-level aggregates and no student records or patient-level protected health information.
